parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   **zh-CN**: Chinese
*   **en-US** (default): English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the access point.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-access-points --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accept-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
